description_en: You can invoke ReleaseCall to hang up the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. The invoker must be an agent and currently in a call
description_zh: 调用ReleaseCall挂断指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，调用者必须是坐席，且正处于通话状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc release-call --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-65382141036850000 --channel-id ch:user:13905010000-_80320000:1609138902226:job-65382141036850000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseCall

parameters.description_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default.
parameters.description_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席。
parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value.
parameters.description_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写。
parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description_en: Channel ID of the call to hang up. This parameter is optional. If not specified, it defaults to the channel where the agent corresponding to the UserId is located.
parameters.description_zh: 待挂断的话务通道ID，非必填，不填默认为当前UserId对应坐席所在的话务通道。
parameters.help_en: Channel ID of the call to hang up. This parameter is optional. If not specified, it defaults to the channel where the agent corresponding to the UserId is located
parameters.help_zh: 待挂断的话务通道ID，非必填，不填默认为当前UserId对应坐席所在的话务通道
parameters.name: channel_id
